scope: Independent adversarial code, schema, boundary, regression and citation-preservation review of the exact four-file Handle implementation; no scientific record acceptance.

assessments.summary: Reference.id is the only newly admitted Handle location. Native fullmatch and generated LinkML syntax agree on the documented bounded subset.

Global biological prefixes and all other LinkML slots are unchanged. Record, taxon, participant, reaction, cluster and both graph-endpoint attempts remain rejected; authority/policy and collector boundary tests pass.
Declared edge and endpoint-qualifier citations pass; undeclared citations still fail native local resolution. LinkML does not implement local cross-reference resolution, as before.

The exact issuing URL, full citation metadata, source version conflict and PDF hash survive page/KGX generation. No Handle graph or KGX node is created. Frozen draft ppi-037 and ppi-038 retain the Handle and all 51 edges retain evidence and qualifiers.

All pre-existing reference prefixes retain acceptance/rejection behavior, and all 229 observed maintained records pass both old/new native validators and generated LinkML JSON schemas. Only Reference.id changes in the generated schema.

The added tests cover positive citations, malformed syntax, local resolution, biological rejection, authority policy and snapshot boundaries, collectors, and exact page/KGX metadata. Independent focused run passed 147 tests; changed Python lint passes.

observed_failure_history: Author package retains its initial two wrong error-message assertions (95 passed, 2 failed); native endpoint rejection was correct and the final focused run passed. No unresolved defect remains from those assertions.

This audit had no failed execution or product test. One reviewer receipt boolean key said four outputs while listing three; the initial receipt/helper are retained and an explicit successor corrects that label after rehashing the three outputs.
limitations: Full maintained gate suite, canonical build, and scientific review were not run or claimed.
The 51-edge draft is the sealed implementation fixture at a0f144cf3191ff3f02daf7cd7c4c0e5ef1d96fa7cc72fa16e132e5819e35f2b0, not a later or final author draft.

The broad syntax/old-corpus matrix used generated LinkML JSON Schema directly; six representative syntax cases additionally invoked the actual LinkML Validator wrapper, and focused pytest invokes that wrapper extensively.
Native validation remains responsible for declared-reference and graph-endpoint resolution. Existing external mappings and provider-local cluster gene strings keep their prior contracts.

The supported Handle grammar is deliberately a subset; no claim about complete Handle-system syntax or resolver behavior is made. An explicit URL is required by this record to produce its issuing citation link.
